Sapphire's walkable filler between and around the two rooms (rows 0-1, 13-19, 31-32 outside the walls) is rock; the six rocks around the regi are Black 2's drock02 (as Black 2's own regi chambers ring their statue with them, chunk 815); the braille wall over the sealed door (7-9,19-20) is Black 2's dotted stone panel d29_door1 (the regi chambers' set 332) standing on the wall's top above the door's arch (Black 2's arch, 3 tiles wide and as high as the wall, covers the braille tiles themselves).
